name: Biome
description: Biome linter/formatter config — organizes imports, sorts keys and attributes, Tailwind-aware CSS parsing.

name: Git Ignore
description: Standard .gitignore covering dependencies, build output, editor files, and local secrets.

name: Git Attributes
description: Normalizes line endings to LF across text files and marks binaries to prevent content conversion.

name: Commitlint
description: Conventional Commits rules — restricts commit types and caps header/body/footer line lengths.

name: Lefthook
description: Git hooks: runs Biome and TypeScript checks on staged files, enforces branch naming and commit message conventions, blocks pushes to main.

name: TypeScript (base)
description: Base tsconfig for non-framework TypeScript projects — strict compiler options, NodeNext modules.

name: TypeScript (Next.js)
description: tsconfig tailored for Next.js — adds JSX, DOM libs, and Next.js path/module resolution.

name: Claude Code Settings
description: Default Claude Code permissions (allow/deny list) and project-wide MCP server settings.

name: Claude Code MCP
description: Registers the context7 MCP server (up-to-date library docs) for Claude Code.

name: Graphify Ignore
description: Excludes dependencies and build output from Graphify's code graph analysis.
